canon-varo-escape.alt: Two cloaked figures stand in a small vessel among golden clouds beside steep striated mountains under a dark sky.
canon-varo-escape.note: This is the complete composition La huida, the third painting of a dispersed triptych. The individual painting is reviewed here; traits are not assigned to the two other panels from this view.
canon-varo-escape.reason: A hand quietly handles the vessel's line or steering apparatus while the travellers mostly stand. Mountains, cloud-filled space and distant terrain form an extensive imagined environment.

present.N: Small vessel, handled line, two differently directed figures and separate mountain passages offer secondary clues.
present.I: The small vessel and standing figures appear unsupported among clouds rather than on water.
present.D: Golden illuminated passages contrast strongly with the dark surrounding sky and terrain.
present.S: The foreground vessel and bodies stand before successive cloud and mountain stages.
present.V: A hand visibly handles the line or steering apparatus at the vessel's front.
present.F: The nearby compact pair occupies a substantial central area.
present.L: Steep rocky mountains and distant terrain substantially organise the view.
present.X: Faces, limbs and the tall bodily silhouettes are conspicuously elongated.
present.P: Rock striations, facial edges, cloth folds and vessel boundaries are finely controlled.
present.R: Recurring vertical rock striations and cloud curls create conspicuous rhythm.
present.M: Cloth folds, rock textures and the vessel's structure have differentiated local description.
present.O: A broad relatively uninterrupted dark sky remains around the upper bodies and mountain.

unknown.B: Fine original paint marks cannot be separated confidently from reproduced cloud and rock texture.
unknown.H: Travelling together does not by itself establish an emphasised exchange between the figures; partly concealed hands leave coordination uncertain.
